goldConnection.title: SIYAYO ACADEMY · GOLD CONNECTION
goldConnection.principle: Corpus abundance does not imply assessment abundance. SIYAYO may expose a growing encyclopedia of verbs, adjectives, nouns, Question Words, perspectives and Experiences while adaptive authority remains explicit and evidence-grounded.

gates.capability: The learner may encounter or explore a meaningful opportunity.
gates.contractAuthority: The skill is mature and explicitly authorized to make contractual pedagogical claims.
gates.assessmentTarget: This Experience explicitly chooses that authorized skill as an assessment target.
gates.evidence: Only observed learner action with valid provenance can satisfy the contract.

toro.meaning: Controlled expansion of meaningful opportunities around a stable learner identity and evidence core.
toro.openings: capabilities exposed by Thinking Mind and canonical corpus
toro.gates: contract authority plus explicit Experience assessment target
toro.expansion: new Experiences, contrasts, lexical families and Question Words become available as grounded opportunities without forcing a single linear path

encyclopediaVision.description: The canonical corpus can grow toward encyclopedia-scale interactivity. Large verb, adjective, noun and Question Word inventories remain reusable structured knowledge until a grounded Experience, diagnostic, comparison, speech activity or assessment contract needs them.
encyclopediaVision.adaptiveRule: Expansion is profile-sensitive: different learners may see, practice, assess and confirm different capability sequences based on evidence, WAIT/Resume state and explicit pedagogical authority.
encyclopediaVision.branchRule: New branches and pages must connect to this authority chain instead of creating independent mastery, score, progression or routing systems.
